comments.text:
Completed implementation of the flexoki-light theme:
- Added standalone static/themes/flexoki-light.css based on Antharchy/Omarchy flexoki-light color palette.
- Added 'flexoki-light' to AVAILABLE_THEMES in markusmd.themes.
- Added [data-theme="flexoki-light"] styles to static/markus.css.
- Added BDD feature scenarios in features/themes.feature and updated features/site.feature.
- Verified with behave (all 75 scenarios passing) and ruff check.
